narration.text: Why 9.58 seconds still stands as the 100-metre record.
He cut his own record from 9.69 seconds.
It was the biggest jump since electronic timing began.
That same year, he ran 200 metres in 19.19.
Most people would need well over twice as long.
So world records show where human biology tops out.
